name: Calçado (Brazil)
description: Horizontal bicolour of yellow over green in the proportions 2:1, with a white disc on the yellow stripe intended for the municipal emblem.
history: Calçado is a municipality in the state of Pernambuco, Brazil. Flags of the World describes the flag with the municipal emblem on the white disc and the name in yellow on the green stripe; the Wikimedia Commons drawing omits both.

features.role: disc on the yellow stripe for the municipal emblem
